content.description: Google Ads Campaign 创建官方示例代码
content.key_finding: 必须使用 client.enums 获取枚举值，不能直接导入枚举类
content.correct_pattern:
# 正确方式：使用 client.enums 获取枚举值
campaign.contains_eu_political_advertising = client.enums.EuPoliticalAdvertisingStatusEnum.DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING

wrong_patterns.error: TypeError: Expected an int, got a boolean

content.code_example_search_campaign:
def create_search_campaign(client, customer_id, budget_resource_name):
    campaign_operation = client.get_type('CampaignOperation')
    campaign = campaign_operation.create
    campaign.name = f'Campaign #{uuid4()}'
    campaign.advertising_channel_type = client.enums.AdvertisingChannelTypeEnum.SEARCH
    campaign.status = client.enums.CampaignStatusEnum.PAUSED
    campaign.campaign_budget = budget_resource_name
    campaign.contains_eu_political_advertising = client.enums.EuPoliticalAdvertisingStatusEnum.DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING
    response = campaign_service.mutate_campaigns(customer_id=customer_id, operations=[campaign_operation])
    return response.results[0].resource_name
content.code_example_app_campaign:
def create_app_campaign(client, customer_id, budget_resource_name):
    campaign_operation = client.get_type('CampaignOperation')
    campaign = campaign_operation.create
    campaign.advertising_channel_type = client.enums.AdvertisingChannelTypeEnum.MULTI_CHANNEL
    campaign.advertising_channel_sub_type = client.enums.AdvertisingChannelSubTypeEnum.APP_CAMPAIGN
    campaign.contains_eu_political_advertising = client.enums.EuPoliticalAdvertisingStatusEnum.DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_EU_POLITICAL_ADVERTISING
    response = campaign_service.mutate_campaigns(customer_id=customer_id, operations=[campaign_operation])
    return response.results[0].resource_name
